verdict.rationale: treg's core interface is a token-authenticated HTTP API with 159 documented operations and an OpenAPI spec. It also ships a CLI installed by a one-line shell script. Both are usable without a UI, so scripts and pipelines can call it headlessly. However, the evidence never documents CI usage directly. The CLI login paths shown (GitHub, emailed OTP, invite code) look interactive, and no non-interactive CI auth is described. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions example), non-interactive CLI auth via env var or service token, independent hands-on confirmation of pipeline use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: One base URL, one token. Call any of 159 documented operations
